parameters.query:
-- «Вместе» subscription gate + daily anti-abuse cap (Task 17a; owner decision 2026-08-26,
-- spec §5.3). ONE statement does lookup, increment and verdict, so a hammering client
-- cannot slip between a read and a write. $1 = appUserId.
--
-- Suggestions are FREE: this NEVER touches dialog_counts. Over-quota is deliberately
-- ALLOWED -- the panel IS the fallback the quota gate routes people into. What is refused:
-- an `expired` subscriber, an id with NO row at all (the id is the only secret this
-- unauthenticated endpoint has, so unknown = no service), and anything past the daily cap.
--
-- The counter row is only ever created for an entitled caller, so an unknown/expired id --
-- the shape an abuser would send -- cannot grow the table either.
with me as (
  select status from subscribers where app_user_id = $1
), today as (
  select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Almaty')::date d   -- same day boundary as dialog_counts
), bump as (
  insert into suggestion_counts (app_user_id, d, n)
  select $1, t.d, 1 from today t
  where (select status from me) in ('active','trialing','grace')
  on conflict (app_user_id, d) do update set n = suggestion_counts.n + 1
  returning n
)
select
  exists(select 1 from me) as known,
  (select status from me) as status,
  (select n from bump) as n,
  -- 100/day/account. `n` is the count INCLUDING this request, so request 101 is the first
  -- refused one. NULL (no bump = not entitled) collapses to false, never NULL: in SQL
  -- `false and NULL` is false, so Gate Decision always gets a real boolean.
  ((select n from bump) is not null and (select n from bump) <= 100) as allowed;
